name: Household memory
description: Keeps what a family member asks the assistant to remember, shows it at the start of every turn in that chat, and finds older chats when someone asks about the past.

ownerPersonId.description: The household person id of the family member whose own thread in the app this assistant is, such as franco.

people.description: Each family member's household person id, as the app's channel names them, and the name to keep their requests under. The owner must be one of them.
